rowe-kennicutt-2009.citation: Rowe and Kennicutt (2009), Northern Gulf of Mexico Continental Slope Habitats and Benthic Ecology Study, Final Report, MMS 2009-039, July 2009.

source_locator: Printed page 83 / PDF page 105, June 2001 paragraph explicitly names Nansen and reports its approximate center. Figure 8-3 printed page 80 / PDF page 102 provides June 10 2001 map date.

findings.nansen: Small slope anticyclone near 28 N, 88.5 W is explicitly distinguished from Millennium near 26 N, 91 W. Approximate source point only, no measured size. Map date is not formation or lifetime. Other formation/separation definitions remain unreconciled.
